entries.title: Corriente de colores (I)
entries.caption:
Me hizo recordar esos días, en donde las lecciones comenzaban a ser duras.

Los demás jugando libremente, mientras cohibida estaba ella en una esquina,

La veían débil, pero lo que no sabían era que estaba planeando algo.

Su vida siempre fue diferente, durante su crecimiento, todo eran celos y envidias que pretendían enraizarla y no dejarla volar.

Desde ese día, decidió convertirse en una roca, para que nada la pudiera mover. Estaba tan sucia por todo el lodo que corroía sus aperladas plumas.

Durante los años, veía a otros de su especie entrar a una corriente de vientos que pasaban esporádicamente cada cierto tiempo. Pareciera que dejara estelas de vapor, formando espirales de colores que dirigen a las esquinas de otros mundos, pero la corriente solo succiona a los ligeros.

Con todas sus fuerzas ella hacía todo para limpiar su aspecto, pero esas alas aperladas no relucían como antes, trataba de volar, pero sus alas todavía eran pesadas.

Un peatón de los muchos que pasaban por el parque decidió llevarla a casa. Le limpiaba las heridas que la irritación de la tierra húmeda le había causado, ella se sentía morir.

Luego de meses de cuidado, el peatón la llevó de regreso al parque. Ella estaba determinada a quedarse en el mismo lugar esperando que la onda de colores volviera a brillar frente a sus ojos.

Pasaban años, y no veía nada. Ella no veía nada. Hasta que un día las vio.

Su felicidad era muy grande, pero estaba extrañada que sus compañeros no volaran hacia los colores brillantes.

Emprendió vuelo, las luces ahora se reflejaban en sus plumas. En cualquier momento, la corriente la tomaría entre sus vapores y la llevaría a un mejor lugar. Ella volaba y volaba, aleteaba, pero no había nada succionándola. Estaba volando mucho más arriba de lo que era usual, pero no iba a parar.

Sentía una presión en su pecho, algo no estaba bien. Sus pulmones ya no funcionaban. Comenzó a perder conciencia. Cayendo en picada, el golpeteo de sus plumas, ella caía.

Recuerdo que fue el momento en donde volteé a ver el cielo y veía algo caer desde lo alto, hasta que cayó sobre el periódico que leía. La fuerza con la que cayó hizo que mis dos fémures se quebraran a la mitad. Inmediatamente las personas de alrededor llamaban a la ambulancia, pero mientras llegaba, delirando del dolor, intentaba ver exactamente qué era lo que había caído sobre mí.

Luego de la operación, me llevaban al cuarto de hospital compartido en donde en la otra cama, se encontraba una mujer, envuelta en vendajes que le cubrían todo el cuerpo menos la cara, parecía no tener forma. El cuarto lo dividía una sencilla cortina de algodón muy delgada, lo que nos permitió conocernos y que me contara su historia.

Dos horas pasaron luego que terminara de contarme su historia, cuando entró el doctor a revisarme y exclamó “Es una suerte que hayas tenido este cuarto solo para ti, raras veces pasa”. Corrió la cortina y no había nadie en

la otra cama, solo estaba la ventana abierta. La vi de lejos, volando de nuevo pero ahora ya dentro de los vapores coloridos.
entries.interpretation: Hurt and imposed isolation, receiving care, patiently pursuing flight, then a mysterious release. Care and envy are distinct from the color imagery.

entries.title: Corriente de colores (II)
entries.caption:
Se siente muy lejos,

Se siente inalcanzable, de esas que estiras la mano y la tocas, pero no está realmente allí.

Los ojos lo ven tan claro como el agua, pero los sentidos no lo perciben

¿Cómo es eso posible?

Volando contra la corriente, tratando de alcanzar,

Desesperadamente. El frío le seca los ojos y la velocidad, mientras más se acerca, desfigura su piel

Si tan solo…

Si tan solo pudiera estirar un poco más

Solo un poco más…

La logra alcanzar. Lo logró. ¡De verdad lo ha logrado!

¿Lo ha logrado?

Se le desvanece de las manos

y comienza a caer en un vacío infinito

Sus plumas revoltosas por la caída,

esa presión en el pecho.

Las piernas desfiguradas por esa misma fuerza que ahora pareciera que la succiona.

Siente las lágrimas dentro de su garganta, pero no logran salir

La garganta se le cierra.

Ya no hay más acceso a la vida.

Cae, cae, pero cae como el peso muerto que ahora es.

Repentinamente siente su pulso otra vez,

Vuelve a abrir los ojos.

¿Sigue con vida?
entries.interpretation: Yearning for the unreachable, exertion and collapse, then a renewed pulse. Water is a comparison, and pulse is returning life, not a game.

entries.title: Nuevo mundo (III)
entries.caption:
Este mundo era diferente

Era real, colorido y brillante.

Los astros brillaban durante el día, y la noche dentro del mar

Que con sus olas rasca las terrazas de los rascacielos

Creciendo alternos a los árboles.

Ahora hay tres capas: las raíces, donde todos viven, la superficie, donde todos expresan sus talentos y el mar, donde todos admiran los astros vivos.

El aire está conformado por viruta de diamantes, por lo que todos usan un filtro en las fosas nasales y la garganta para poder soportarlo. Los ojos poco a poco se adecúan al dolor.

Inhalo

Exhalo

Por alguna razón se siente bien

Se siente bien en este nuevo mundo en el que ha aterrizado

Un sentimiento de orgullo le llena

Ese vacío en el que, por un momento, ella caía.

Ella todavía no reside, apenas es una nómada que duerme en las calles mientras le pisotean sus alas.

Pero está viva, en una nueva oportunidad,

Ella cree que es real, y podría serlo.
entries.interpretation: Wonder in an unfamiliar world, painful adaptation and survival. Pride here is accomplishment; the nomad is not yet at home.

entries.title: Primeros días en el Nuevo Mundo (IV)
entries.caption:
No tengo idea por qué estoy aquí.

Luché por tantos años por seguir lo que veía, lo que tenía enfrente de mis ojos,

Y ahora aquí, estoy tirada en la calle de un lugar oscuro, sin luz.

Yo vivía de los rayos solares que suaves rozaban mi piel y mis plumas a veces brillaban por tantas vitaminas que nutrían su fuerza y agilidad.

Aquí no se puede volar, aquí no hay cielo, hay mar.

Quiero llegar a tocarlo, pero no sé cómo escalar

Esos altos edificios que intimidan hasta al más poderoso, no sé si voy a poder más.

Encontré una cueva, formada por la raíz de una Ceiba.

La gente tira sus desechos aquí, pero en una esquina, encontré un artefacto,

Como en el mundo del que vengo le dirían, un piano.

No tengo ni idea cómo se usa, solo lo he escuchado.

La combinación de teclas es deliciosa para mis tímpanos que resuenan a su sonar.

Necesito esas notas para volver a sentir esa pasión que algún día tuve.

Pero ahora solo veo las teclas enlodadas, igual que mis preciosas alas.

Es lo único que tengo, es lo único a lo que le confío.

Tengo que volverme a construir, a lijar mis garras para poder trepar esos edificios

Y poder llegar

A tocar esas aguas majestuosas que quizás me den una pista para saber por dónde seguir

Esta ruta que, sin saberlo, elegí.

Pero para mientras, toco una triste melodía

Que consiste de tan solo tres notas seguidas.

Si las toco lentamente, arrullan mi alma

Y, por fin, logro descansar.
entries.interpretation: Disorientation and effort to rebuild, then trust in music, a gentle melody and rest. The lack of light is not equivalent to present serenity.

entries.title: Relatos del civil (V)
entries.caption:
Intenté contarles a todos, pero nadie me creyó.

Culparon a la anestesia por mis delirios.

Mi insistencia hizo que me mandaran a meses de terapia,

Pero nadie nunca entendió.

En las noticias hablaron de mí un par de días,

Ya que una empresa constructora tomó la culpa

De la viga de hierro, que quebró mis huesos.

Nunca entendí por qué crearon tantas falsas historias con tal de cubrir mi verdad.

Todavía me cuesta andar. Mi terapista dice que me tomará un año regresar a la normalidad.

Mi vida es normal, es simple.

Pero ese día me cambió,

Cambió mi percepción.

Siempre pensé que las oportunidades caen del cielo, y precisamente fue así

Una oportunidad, una historia, que ahora la transformé en una nueva forma de vida.

Nunca realmente llegué a verla detenidamente… eso me hubiera gustado.

Mi reflejo en el espejo me hace recordar, melancolías.

Escuchar su historia; esa voz de fuego.

Acaricio mis mejillas, trayendo recuerdos de amores pasados.

Podía sentir bajo mi piel cómo la sangre circulaba.

Mis pupilas siempre han sido así.

Otra vez me sentí despierto.

La derecha dilatada y la izquierda no. Me hace sentir especial, por aquel famoso que lo hizo popular.

Su aroma era suave y delicado, no iba con su personalidad.

No entiendo qué hacer ahora. Mi propio reflejo me lo dice.

Tengo una casa, tengo un carro, tengo una familia, o solía tenerla…

Puede que ya no tenga mucho tiempo, o quizás sí.

Quizás y solo quizás, si pudiera volverle a hablar, verla volar...

Qué no daría por verla otra vez, alcanzando sus amados vientos de colores…
entries.interpretation: Being disbelieved, trying to make sense of experience, and remembering love and family. Memory, doubt and belonging matter more than bodily nouns.

entries.title: Pensamientos del alma (VI)
entries.caption:
El suelo de ambos mundos se estremece

Por las pasiones que pudieron pasar, pero nunca fueron.

Ella se asoma a una de las calles, sus brazos aún están débiles y le cuesta salir de la

cueva.

Puede ver cómo los tintes púrpuras de este nuevo lugar reflejan sobre la piel de sus

manos.

Una tercera mano aparece, y le ofrece ayuda, pero retira la mano y corre de nuevo a

su piano.

...

Lo siento, no soy nadie único.

Mi vida es simple y la verdad es que quisiera ser especial.

Los cuentos de amor ya no me calan bajo la piel, solo algunos, antes eran la

mayoría.

Ya no sé qué hacer, de verdad. Quisiera nada más saltar todos los pasos que hay para

llegar al mar,

Pero es completamente imposible. Quiero pasar de la A a la Z, pero no se puede.

¿Será que mas de algún ser vivo lo ha hecho?

Tiene que haber un atajo, sin que tenga repercusiones.

¡¡Me lo prometieron!! ¡Todos me lo prometieron! ¡Era siempre tan fácil y ahora que

me toca a mí, no lo es!

En este momento, incluso dudo si siquiera sé escribir o leer. Soy un cuerpo relleno

de órganos y fluidos que hacen que esta farsa funcione.

No tengo nada, ni siquiera me tengo a mí.

¿En dónde más busco?

Es todo un romanticismo; el sentarme en el piano, para pensar tristes melodías…

pero luego de eso, ¿qué? ¿Quién me viene a salvar?

¿Alguien me salva?
entries.interpretation: Withdrawn self-doubt, refused help, longing for shortcuts, and expression at the piano. Asking to be saved expresses a need for help, without asserting a religious belief.

entries.title: Querido diario,
entries.caption:
Aquí estoy comenzando de nuevo

Puede que sea uno lento

Duele el orgullo intentar pintar algo y que todo falle.

No importa con cuántas ganas lo hice. Sin técnica no hay paraíso

Mi padre sigue trabajando en el viñedo. Lo extraño. Él no tiene ni idea de mi cambio de carrera

Solo pienso en regresar a esas largas praderas y correr junto al viento. Pero me he jurado no regresar hasta que logre hacerte orgulloso papá.

Con toda la esperanza del mundo comencé un lienzo, uno grande, pero al dibujar lo que quería, fallé.

Se sintió como caer de un edificio sin paracaídas.

Caí sin llegar al piso. Una caída infinita como un torbellino cargándome y colocándome lentamente en el pavimento.

Acostada en el piso, viendo hacia el cielo, tratando de encontrar las fuerzas para volverme a parar.

Parpadeo lento, puedo oler eucalipto y ver un cielo celeste y nubes blancas pasar.
¡Qué atrevido el mundo que sigue dando vueltas mientras yo ni me puedo parar!

Sé que tengo que volver a empezar.

Soy un nómada de profesiones. Cambiando de una a otra. A veces siento que vuelo, pero sin alas. Algún día lo voy a lograr y te prometo papá que volveré triunfante.
entries.interpretation: Failure, learning, longing for one's father and choosing to begin again. Vineyard and meadow are remembered belonging, not automatically calm.

entries.title: Energética muerte
entries.caption:
Tengo acelerado el corazón

Nunca me había sentido tan cerca de la muerte

Tan cerca que me toca las manos y helada me deja.

La sangre ya solo en la cara me queda

Porque la demás a mi pasión le hereda.

Ese miedo cada noche al irme a dormir

Sin saber si otro día podré vivir.

Es la energía que me levanta al amanecer

Con esa euforia, que, en el ocaso, vuelve y me aterra.

Es como si una nueva persona se vistió de mi piel

Y la maneja sin piedad

La lleva a sus límites y no sabe hasta dónde podrá más.

Mis lágrimas son de fuego y queman

Cuando caen por mi tez

Pero con la misma energía que una vez cayeron,

Regresan a su hogar para confortarme

De nuevo y empezar el día una vez más.

05/26/20
entries.interpretation: Fear and relentless energy alternate with dawn, comfort and restarting. Home and comfort are the clearest security anchors.

entries.title: Sin salida
entries.caption:
Incluso se me acabaron las lágrimas de tanto llorar.

Mi tez ahora acostumbrada, se reseca cuando no siente esas gotas.

Tuve dinero y no amor y no lo quise. Tengo amor y no dinero y sigue infeliz.

No sé qué más, me pregunto si es correcto el camino que elegí ya que nada se siente bien,

O solo es un momento de esos amargos de la vida, lo único que tengo que

Hacer es aguantar, aguantar un poco más en esta agonía,

La desesperación de no poder salir, el sentimiento

De encierro, de impotencia.

Trato de ayudar, no me dejan ayudar

Trato de crear, tengo que estudiar muchísimo para lograr hacerlo bien

Lo hago bien, a los de la institución no les interesa.

Ya ni los títulos hacen sentido si solo

Los regalan sin valor alguno.

Puedes estar en un país primer mundista,

Gente muere por estar aquí, y ahora que vivo en una de las ciudades más prestigiosas,

La odio con todo mi corazón. Nada me satisface. Hago todos mis pasatiempos, pero nada me complace.

Ya los hice todos, ya me cansé. Me cansé de ser una niña mantenida,

Tengo todas las herramientas posibles para salir al mundo

Pero ahora resulta que todo depende de la residencia.

Es imposible ser libre en este mundo.

Es completamente imposible.

Vivir siempre con el miedo de estar haciéndolo mal.

Escribo, ¡Me emociono por algo por fin!

Y recibo mensajes hostiles por no haber puesto una mayúscula.

Ni siquiera en un mundo en línea encuentro esa libertad.

Claro, la vida tiene sus altos y sus bajos.

Lo preocupante es

Cuando los bajos

Comienzan a ser

Mucho más constantes

Hirientes

Sin salida.
entries.interpretation: Feeling blocked despite love and tools, wanting to help/create, persevering, and briefly finding excitement in writing. Freedom is sought, not already possessed.

entries.title: Aurel
entries.caption: Aurel is its own world. It begins with a voice that feels trapped, moves into a beat, and opens into virtuosic piano. Given time, it carries the listener from one place to another.

entries.title: Nebuú
entries.caption: Nebuú was originally titled “The Story of King Nebuú.” The track tells the life story of a fictional character who lives in my imagination. I later reshaped the ending into a more pop influenced experience, giving listeners a familiar and relatable way back from his world.
entries.scene: Trembling waves symbolize the uncertainty of life before gradually transforming into a warmer, more familiar world. A person emerges from isolation and learns to connect with others through love.
entries.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led, Electronic / experimental, Pop
entries.interpretation: Uncertainty and isolation gradually give way to love, familiarity and belonging.

entries.title: Crystal
entries.caption: Crystal is a song about living in the clouds and looking down at the world. It expresses the superego, an observing perspective that sees life from above. The song is meant to capture the feeling of stepping outside yourself and viewing everything from a distance.
entries.scene: A figure sits quietly among luminous clouds, looking out across a dreamlike sky washed in pink, violet, and gold. Suspended above the world, the figure observes from a distance, surrounded by softness, light, and peaceful introspection. A geometric window floats in the distance, suggesting another world or perspective.

entries.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led

entries.title: Green Tea
entries.caption: Green Tea is a fight for survival. It begins with heaviness, settles into calm in the middle, and reaches a powerful resolution that feels less like an ending and more like a continuation. This is a story that rewards patient listening and allows its narrative to unfold over time.
entries.scene: A woman finds herself trapped in a game where every choice carries a cost. Surrounded by temptation, greed, and uncertainty, she must decide what she is willing to protect and what she might sacrifice to survive. As the world around her becomes increasingly chaotic, survival begins to feel like a game.
entries.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led, Electronic / experimental
entries.interpretation: A costly choice about what to protect under pressure; survival and responsibility.

entries.title: Aurelillo
entries.caption: Aurelillo is meant to be a deeply relaxing trance piece that serves as the album’s outro. After the chaos of Green Tea, it brings the listener into a place of calm, closing this album while gently leading into the next.
entries.scene: The sensation of floating weightlessly through a soft, open space as a gentle tingling spreads through the body. Colors and light slowly shift, signaling completion and carrying the moment from one chapter into the next.
entries.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful
entries.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led
entries.interpretation: Weightless relaxation closes one chapter while gently opening another.

entries.title: que Soñaba en el piano
entries.caption: I wrote this song while sitting at the piano after receiving unexpected criticism from someone close to me about a musical collaboration. I was trying to process the response and the doubt it created. Was my judgment that far off? Could I no longer distinguish between something good and something sloppy? Was I becoming sloppy myself? The experience deeply unsettled me, and the song emerged from that confusion.
entries.scene: A quiet room after a difficult conversation. The piano remains still while the same words replay in the mind, creating a pause filled with questions. Nothing outwardly changes, but the familiar space feels different as confidence quietly gives way to uncertainty.
entries.genre: New Age / meditative, Singer songwriter
entries.interpretation: Criticism from someone close unsettles confidence; reflection has not yet resolved the doubt.

entries.title: David Jones Snow
entries.caption: You want a tense song? David Jones Snow is your song. It answers the doubts raised by the previous track. Forget all of that. This is my world, and I create the sounds I want. I am willing to be vulnerable and share their chaos because they express something real to me. It is the feeling of saying, “Oh yes. No one is stopping me. Here we go again.”
entries.scene: A boat pushes forward through towering waves, carried by a melody that refuses to stop. The wind and water scrape against the skin, leaving scars from the journey, yet the boat continues through the storm regardless.
entries.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led
entries.interpretation: Defending an authentic creative voice through resistance, vulnerability and scars.

entries.title: Dream 2
entries.caption: This song builds on the foundation of another song that is dear to me, using its powerful synths to create something energetic and fun. My sister felt inspired by the music and sent me a set of English lyrics. I selected the lines that fit the song, edited them, and incorporated some of them into the final version. I sing them with a strong accent, since Spanish is my first language, and I embrace that playfulness throughout the track. At one point, I even say, “I don’t even know what I said, for real.”
entries.scene: A woman sits motionless in the center of a room while everything around her continues to move. She feels defeated, and even as she travels from place to place, the same pain follows and weighs on her. Life begins to feel like sleepwalking through a dream until she can no longer tell whether she is awake, asleep, or simply going through the motions. Exhausted, she wants only to return to sleep and dream again.
entries.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led, Singer songwriter
entries.interpretation: The scene conveys exhaustion, continuing pain and blurred waking/dreaming; the playful production is secondary.

entries.title: Tortilla Song
entries.caption: Tortilla Song is a funny song to me. It is tense and loud, yet it makes a quiet statement. It may seem like I do not know what I am doing, but I actually have a clear direction. It is playful, energetic, and filled with the sound of trumpets.
entries.scene: A form holds the marks left by pressure. Those traces gradually become part of its character, revealing something authentic and individual. The scene carries tension and playfulness together: an apparent imperfection can belong to a clear creative direction.
entries.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led, Electronic / experimental
entries.interpretation: Pressure leaves marks that become part of an authentic, individual form. Tension and playfulness coexist with a clear creative direction. Heat is a secondary metaphorical connection, not the track’s literal subject.

entries.title: Cowgirl
entries.caption: Cowgirl Song is my interpretation of a phrase that has stayed in my head for a long time. I combined it with the idea of the heroes of the night and the catchy, repeated Ahooah!
entries.scene: A lightheaded moment of floating freely, laughing, and saying nonsense while still believing that heroes will come to carry you safely through the night
entries.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective
entries.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Singer songwriter
entries.interpretation: Floating and laughing while trusting others to carry you safely through the night.

entries.title: Wait for me UNO
entries.caption: In music, counting is very important, especially finding your way back to the first beat so everything stays consistent. I sometimes struggle with that, so this song represents my constant chase of the one. That is why it is called “Wait for Me, Uno.” I am calling out, “Wait for me! Uno, wait!” The song turns that musical chase into its own story.
entries.scene: Numbers move in a repeating circle while the number one keeps slipping just out of reach. Each time the rhythm seems ready to settle, the pattern shifts and the chase begins again. The scene feels playful rather than desperate, like trying to catch the first beat before the music moves forward without you.
entries.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Peaceful
entries.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led
entries.interpretation: A playful repeated pursuit of the beat, rather than a frightening repetition.

entries.title: Dar
entries.caption: Dar is a song I created around the B major and B minor scales. Moving between them creates captivating melodic lines and a sense of emotional tension. The song represents giving yourself fully to a mission.
entries.scene: The scene captures the Annunciation at the moment the Angel Gabriel reveals the Virgin Mary’s mission. Fear comes first, followed by humility, wonder, and a growing sense of hope. She feels overwhelmed that she has been chosen, yet she recognizes her strength and accepts what lies ahead. Her emotions move through the uncertainty of “Yes. Yes! Yes? Wait... I said yes, YES.” holding emotions at the same time.
entries.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful
entries.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led
entries.interpretation: Fear, humility and hope accompany accepting a responsibility, inspired by Mary's Annunciation.

entries.title: romA
entries.caption: romA is written backward, which is why the capital letter appears at the end. When reversed, it becomes Amor, the Spanish word for love. The track captures a moment created with love, with birds chirping live, life unfolding in the background, and my piano flowing alongside it. I love you.
entries.scene: A room with large windows overlooking trees and palm trees, with birds flying across a blue Nevada sky filled with cinematic clouds. A piano sits near the window while cars pass below, a bus stops, and everyday life continues. The scene feels open and alive, as though the song itself is breathing with the world outside.
entries.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful
entries.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led
entries.interpretation: Love opens into everyday life: piano, birds, a window and the world continuing outside.

entries.title: OOO2
entries.caption: I spent an entire day writing OOO2, completely dedicated to it. There was no food and no distractions, only the song and its flow. Inspired by the sinking boat scene in Life of Pi, the track feels both tense and weightless. You move through it as if struggling against a persistent droning current.
entries.scene: A ship moves through the night toward an unfamiliar destination. Inside a small cabin, anticipation is mixed with unease. Then the vessel begins to sink. Panic spreads through the corridors as alarms and Morse code distress signals cut through the darkness. Everything tilts, shifts, and falls. The deep blue ocean becomes now this black liquid before your eyes, demanding your body, your blood, and your soul as the struggle against drowning takes over.
entries.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led
entries.interpretation: A nocturnal sinking ship, panic and bodily struggle against drowning; no peaceful shore is promised.

entries.title: Anoche
entries.caption: Anoche is a reinterpretation of “Que Soñaba en el Piano” from the album SDLC_02. It combines different genres, styles, and harmonies, all moving toward one goal: making the song fun to listen to.
entries.scene: A vast, quiet room filled with soft light. A woman kneels in the center, facing the Tabernacle, while another version of herself speaks to her and tries to pull her away. She remains still and focused. The scene then shifts into ordinary daily life, where she sits at her piano as news, conversations, and human experiences continue to reach her. She takes everything in and tries to understand it, firmly repeating, “No, no,” because nothing will separate her from Him.
entries.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Contemporary instrumental, Singer songwriter, Electronic / experimental
entries.interpretation: Remaining faithful and focused amid distractions; then bringing daily life back to the piano.

entries.title: The Rebellion
entries.caption: The Rebellion moves through two competing flows, with the piano and drums constantly colliding to create a restless, confrontational sound. It carries anger toward the injustices found in human relationships and everyday life. It is the feeling of being unable to leave while becoming increasingly frustrated with staying.
entries.scene: Two opposing currents move through the same confined space, one fluid and deliberate, the other sharp and relentless. They collide again and again, but neither can escape or overpower the other. The space fills with tension as every impact reflects the frustration of being forced to remain inside a system
entries.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led
entries.interpretation: Anger at injustice inside an inescapable system: opposed forces remain in conflict.

entries.title: John 3:16
entries.caption: I attended Mass, where John 3:16 was part of the Gospel reading. I felt inspired to create a melody that could accompany the passage, giving the listener space to read, pray, and reflect.
entries.scene: "For God so loved the world that he gave his only Son". John 3:16
entries.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful, Faith
entries.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led
entries.interpretation: A quiet space for God's self-giving love, prayer and reflection; care and generosity are the emotional bridge.

entries.title: Sandais
entries.caption: This was an unexpected recording. I simply started playing, and the piece evolved while I was lucky enough to be recording. It became a beautiful transitional song filled with unexpected changes. It feels playful, constant, intriguing, and completely centered on the piano.
entries.scene: A quiet space suspended in anticipation, filled with the feeling that something is about to happen. A steady pulse moves beneath the silence, creating tension that continues to build. Suddenly, the space opens into a rush of color, movement, and emotion, releasing everything that had been waiting underneath.
entries.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Tense, Warm
entries.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led
entries.interpretation: An exploratory piano pulse in anticipation suddenly releases color and movement.

entries.title: Lo que vibra en la vida
entries.caption: I created this song using a scale of Neapolitan Dorian (Spanish origin) to honor the stories of my grandfather and great grandfather. It reflects their struggles and the honorable choices they made, which helped make the life I live today possible.
entries.scene: At dawn, a shipwrecked man reaches the shore of an unfamiliar land. Exhausted and carrying almost nothing, he looks back at the ocean and understands that everything he once knew has been left behind. He gathers the courage to walk toward a new life. As the unfamiliar town begins to wake, he finds work and accepts every sacrifice placed before him. His labor allows his siblings to study and build futures of their own. While they open books and enter classrooms, he continues working quietly, finding dignity and purpose in giving them the opportunities he had to leave behind.
entries.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Tense, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful
entries.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Singer songwriter
entries.interpretation: Starting over in a foreign land through honorable sacrifice for one's family.

entries.title: I hate to love you
entries.caption: This track explores a relationship of love and hate with something you feel compelled to do. You love the process, even though the task leaves scars. You know the struggle is necessary because it will help you grow, so you continue. In the end, you hate how much you love it.
entries.scene: A small classroom with only a musician and a teacher. The musician presents work that has never been shared this openly before. The teacher listens closely and offers a direct critique. The moment feels vulnerable and uncomfortable, but it is also necessary. The choice becomes clear. Accept the discomfort, learn from it, and continue moving forward without stopping.
entries.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental
entries.interpretation: Accepting uncomfortable criticism to learn and continue a creative practice one loves.

entries.title: Don Perro
entries.caption: My teacher challenged me to create a song with a more “solid beat”. For some reason, my brain interpreted that as, “Do they want me to make something predictable, like reggaeton? Ugh.” So I did. I created a reggaeton song in my own style. It is Susi’s one and only reggaeton song, built around a single lyric: “What are you gonna do, Mr. Dog?” Irreverent and playful.
entries.scene: A lively Spanish bar filled with small wooden tables, shared plates, cold drinks, bright lights, and overlapping conversations. Friends move between tables, laughing loudly and saying whatever comes to mind. The scene feels familiar yet rebellious, as if everyone belongs while refusing to behave like everyone else. It is playful, unapologetic, and completely comfortable with its own absurdity.
entries.mood: Cinematic, Playful, energetic, irreverent, humorous, bold, rhythmic.
entries.genre: Contemporary instrumental, Electronic / experimental, Reggaeton, Latin, experimental.
entries.interpretation: Shared laughter, rebellious play and an unapologetically personal voice.

entries.title: Disdain
entries.caption: Disdain is about an ugly feeling that surfaced one day when I experienced genuine envy toward someone. I examined the emotion and realized how much it felt like poison spreading through my heart and entire body. I wrote the song from the perspective of rejecting that feeling, addressing it directly and declaring that I never want to experience it again.
entries.scene: An employee has spent years arriving early, staying late, and becoming highly capable at the work. A new person joins the company and immediately receives the same salary without having the same experience or abilities. Resentment begins to grow as the employee watches the unfairness unfold. Then comes the realization that envy is causing more harm than the situation itself. Disgusted by the feeling, the employee chooses to release it and return attention to their own path before the bitterness takes control.
entries.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano led
entries.interpretation: Examining envy and unfairness, then rejecting the resentment and returning to one's own path.

entries.title: Te Quiero
entries.caption: Te Quiero is a song I wrote after being ill for some time in a foreign country. It is about moving through a tunnel and finally seeing a distant light. Even the smallest glimpse brings hope, along with the realization that the only way to reach it is by learning true self love.
entries.scene: A winged figure sits inside a dark cave, her wings three times the size of her body. Mud covers the feathers, hiding their natural pearl white color. Deep within the cave, she discovers an old grand piano. She does not know what it is or how to use it, but she sits down and gently places one finger on a key. A sweet sound fills the cave and immediately captures her. She begins pressing more keys, discovering endless combinations of notes capable of expressing every part of her life. The melodies are not created so she will be remembered. They are necessary for her survival. Everything she has carried inside can finally leave her through the music. The sounds feel as though they must be released and shared rather than kept within her.
entries.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful
entries.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Singer songwriter
entries.interpretation: Rebuilding oneself in a dark cave; discovering piano as expression, survival and a way toward hope.

entries.title: ...25 (Bonus Track)
entries.caption: This is a traditional Catholic Christmas carol from Spain, I believe. My husband Francisco and I were in DrummerLab’s practice studio. As he played, I began singing the carol and suddenly decided to record it and add harmonies. I consider it a bonus track because it preserves the feeling of a rehearsal. At the end, I intentionally left in a conversation about editing the song and its pitch. I chose not to clean it up because that unpolished moment became part of the song’s character.
entries.scene: A group of family and friends gathers on a quiet street in Spain on a cold Christmas night. They are wrapped in winter coats, scarves, hats, and gloves as their breath becomes visible in the air. Warm streetlights illuminate the buildings and stone pavement while the group sings together, filling the night with voices, laughter, and the repeated sound of “fum, fum, fum.” Neighbors listen from nearby windows and doorways as the familiar carol brings warmth and community into the winter street.
entries.genre: New Age / meditative, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental
entries.interpretation: The warm memory of a shared Catholic Christmas carol: family, community and belonging on a cold night.

entries.title: Linden Ocean
entries.caption: It starts with a sense of tension, but keeps moving forward before easing into restful piano chords. Then it shifts abruptly to a deep synth that really comes through on headphones; on other speakers, it can sound too heavy. Finally, it settles into a calm, dry sound that feels like relief.
entries.scene: A calm sea at first. The water gradually gathers force, as if something is approaching. A sudden disturbance breaks the surface, leaving the sea restless and uncertain. Then the water recedes. Dry land, finally.
entries.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano-led
entries.interpretation: An unsettled sea moves through mounting tension and a disturbance to relief on firm ground.

entries.title: Logic
entries.caption: Logic is a trance track built around a repeating pattern. Melodies layer over it, sometimes transforming the underlying beat. The changes unfold gradually, without abrupt shifts.
entries.scene: An ordinary town at dusk. Streetlights hum, windows glow, and the wind moves through the trees. The same view returns throughout the scene, but each time, the light, shadows, and distant movement have shifted slightly. Nothing announces the change. The repetition becomes hypnotic, then quietly unsettling, as the familiar town begins to feel wrong.
entries.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano-led
entries.interpretation: Repetition slowly makes a familiar place strange; subtle unease grows without a sudden crisis.

entries.title: El Tuki Tuki
entries.caption: It’s a collection of melodies that simply work together, mixed with background sounds that add texture and weave in the experience that inspired the song.
entries.scene: It's 4th of July, you are with the group of friends playing games in a very nice place. Then alot of different scenes happen where they were walking in the parking lot. Talking in the lobby, grilling and eating, and at the end, at the pool wathichng the fireworks
entries.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano-led
entries.interpretation: Remembering an ordinary shared day: games, conversation, friends and small joyful moments.

entries.title: Magical Project
entries.caption: It has a calm, unhurried flow that rewards patient listening, then takes an unexpected turn at the end.
entries.scene: A quiet forest in early autumn. The camera moves slowly along a trail, lingering on light through the leaves and the gentle movement of the trees. Nothing seems unusual at first. As the music continues, a soft light between two trees becomes more noticeable. At the final turn, the camera returns to that spot and reveals a radiant figure in white. The late reveal draws on the account of Our Lady of Champion’s appearance in the woods.
entries.mood: Atmospheric, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful
entries.genre: Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano-led
entries.interpretation: Patient attention to a peaceful woodland leads to wonder; the source scene reveals Our Lady of Champion.

entries.title: songon B
entries.caption: This track feels like someone telling you a story. The music follows a character’s journey through discovery, the weight of responsibility, and the gradual growth into a hero. It has the scale and wonder of an adventure.
entries.scene:
Subdued piano keys accompany an arrival at a ballroom: leaving a coat, taking a drink, exchanging pleasantries. Then the doors open to the main room, and its scale and architecture inspire awe. A hymn rises, and everyone begins to hum along.
The moment bursts apart. Crystals fly through the air and fall into a space where metal rods bounce up from the floor. Finally, the scene settles in a New York park. A bicycle is hard to get moving, so the rider shifts their weight forward with each push of the pedals.
entries.genre: Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano-led, Electronic / experimental
entries.interpretation: Discovery expands into wonder, responsibility and the effort of growing into a hero.

entries.title: Project 0
entries.caption: A Day at a Time is another possible title for this track. It’s about living with uncertainty and still choosing to move forward. A tense, grounding bass holds the music steady while a light melody roams above it.
entries.scene: A student struggles to pass his courses while facing difficult circumstances in his life. He keeps pushing, choosing to continue and try one more time. He stays focused on the present while holding on to hope for the future.
entries.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Neoclassical / piano-led
entries.interpretation: Holding steady one day at a time: continuing to try despite difficult circumstances and uncertainty.

entries.title: Oración A Jesús
entries.caption: Esta cancion es sobre la oracion. como es que cuando comenzamos a rezr pasamos por este ciclo de distracciones, adaptacion hasta que realmente logramos alcanzar esa paz y estado de meditacion en Dios.
entries.scene: A person sits down to pray. As she remains still, her thoughts come to life around her, showing how difficult it is to quiet her mind and enter a contemplative state.
entries.genre: New Age / meditative, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano-led
entries.interpretation: The effort of quieting a distracted mind opens into prayer and contemplation in God.

entries.title: Elbe
entries.caption: Elbe is about reaching stability. It feels comfortable and steady throughout, with no sudden turns or surprises.
entries.scene: A house overlooking the ocean. At dusk, a fire burns on the sand while the waves roll in gently. Warm light glows from the house behind it. The scene lingers there, calm and secure, with everything feeling just right.
entries.genre: Cinematic / soundtrack, Neoclassical / piano-led
entries.interpretation: A steady, safe place: gentle water, warm fire and home stay secure throughout.

entries.title: Lala
entries.caption: A brief, outro-like passage that gathers the feeling of everything that came before it. Lala marks a culmination while remaining weightless and in motion, a closing moment that still seems to float, carrying the listener gently into what follows.
entries.scene: A vast, weightless space surrounded by a purple gradient that shifts from deep violet to lavender. A few indistinct forms float slowly through it, hinting at what came before. Their movement gradually slows until everything seems suspended in one moment. It feels like a culmination, followed by the quiet release of letting it end.
entries.genre: Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano-led
entries.interpretation: An outro-like culmination still floating: transition, weightless suspension and sleeplessness. Missing someone, grief and nostalgic memory are not primary signals.

entries.title: Seda
entries.caption: This track feels like an encore, the song an artist plays when the audience applauds for one more. It’s a graceful piano piece that gives the album its final, golden bow.
entries.scene: A pianist plays a piano among tall trees, facing the sunlight filtering through their leaves. As the final notes ring out, the camera rises from the keys to the view on the album cover: branches framing a bright sun against the sky. The shot holds there as the music fades, giving the album a peaceful ending.
entries.mood: Atmospheric, Cinematic, Dreamlike, Ethereal, Warm, Reflective, Peaceful
entries.genre: New Age / meditative, Cinematic / soundtrack, Ambient / atmospheric, Contemporary instrumental, Neoclassical / piano-led
entries.interpretation: A graceful piano farewell framed by trees and golden sunlight: completion, warmth and quiet appreciation.

entries.title: Primera Morada.Capítulo 1.
entries.caption: Teresa invita a reconocer la dignidad del alma y la presencia de Dios en su interior. La oración atenta abre ese encuentro: volver hacia dentro permite conocerse mejor, cuidar la propia vida y alegrarse de los dones que Dios concede también a otros.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa invites us to recognise the soul’s dignity and God’s presence within it. Attentive prayer opens this encounter: turning inward helps us know ourselves, care for our inner life, and rejoice in the gifts God also grants to others.

entries.title: Primera Morada.Capítulo 2.
entries.caption: Teresa relaciona el conocimiento propio con mirar a Dios: reconocer nuestros límites debe abrirnos a su ayuda y al amor al prójimo. Advierte que encerrarse en las propias faltas, los intereses mundanos o los defectos ajenos puede oscurecer esa atención y debilitar la caridad.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa connects self-knowledge with looking towards God: recognising our limits should open us to His help and to love of neighbour. Dwelling on our faults, worldly interests, or other people’s shortcomings can obscure that attention and weaken charity.

entries.title: Segunda Morada.Capítulo 1.
entries.caption: Teresa muestra cómo el deseo de acercarse a Dios convive con hábitos que nos hacen retroceder. Invita a perseverar en la oración, volver con suavidad después de las caídas y buscar buena compañía, confiando en su misericordia y disponiendo la voluntad a la suya.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa shows how the desire to draw closer to God can coexist with habits that pull us back. She encourages perseverance in prayer, a gentle return after setbacks, and supportive company, trusting His mercy and aligning our will with His.

entries.title: Tercera Morada.Capítulo 1.
entries.caption: Una vida ordenada prepara el camino, pero para Teresa no da derecho a exigir consuelos de Dios. La humildad permite seguir amando y sirviendo aun en la sequedad de la oración, con un amor que se demuestra en obras y una voluntad dispuesta a entregarse.
entries.summaryEN: An orderly life prepares the way, but Teresa says it does not entitle us to demand consolation from God. Humility allows us to keep loving and serving through dryness in prayer, with love expressed in actions and a willingness to give ourselves.

entries.title: Tercera Morada.Capítulo 2.
entries.caption: Para Teresa, las pequeñas contrariedades pueden revelar apegos que una vida correcta deja ocultos. Reconocerlos con humildad abre el camino a una mayor libertad interior: soltar la necesidad de imponer la propia voluntad, mirar las propias faltas y crecer en amor, justicia y obras.
entries.summaryEN: For Teresa, small setbacks can reveal attachments that an outwardly upright life leaves hidden. Recognising them with humility opens the way to greater inner freedom: releasing the need to impose our will, examining our faults, and growing in love, justice, and good works.

entries.title: Cuarta Morada.Capítulo 1.
entries.caption: Para Teresa, la oración se sostiene en amar a Dios, incluso cuando la imaginación sigue inquieta. Comprender esa diferencia ayuda a perseverar con paciencia y a valorar la firmeza del amor por encima de las emociones o la ausencia de distracciones.
entries.summaryEN: For Teresa, prayer is sustained by loving God, even when the imagination remains restless. Understanding this distinction helps us persevere patiently and value steadfast love more than strong emotions or freedom from distraction.

entries.title: Cuarta Morada.Capítulo 2.
entries.caption: Teresa describe una paz interior que nace de Dios y ensancha el alma más allá de lo que puede lograr por su esfuerzo. Invita a amar sin exigir recompensas, recibir sus dones con humildad y reconocer su verdad en las obras que vienen después.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa describes an inner peace that comes from God and enlarges the soul beyond what effort alone can achieve. She invites us to love without demanding rewards, receive His gifts humbly, and recognise their truth in the actions that follow.

entries.title: Cuarta Morada.Capítulo 3.
entries.caption: Teresa describe un recogimiento en el que Dios atrae suavemente el alma hacia sí. Invita a recibirlo sin forzar la mente y a reconocer sus frutos en una mayor libertad interior, confianza y disposición para servir, cuidando también la salud.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa describes a recollection in which God gently draws the soul towards Himself. She encourages receiving it without forcing the mind and recognising its fruits in greater inner freedom, trust, and readiness to serve, while also caring for one’s health.

entries.title: Quinta Morada.Capítulo 1.
entries.caption: Teresa presenta la unión con Dios como un don que supera las propias fuerzas y deja una certeza profunda de su presencia. La disposición del alma consiste en entregarse con sencillez y humildad, sin pretender producir ni comprender por completo esa experiencia.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa presents union with God as a gift beyond our own powers, leaving a deep certainty of His presence. The soul’s part is to surrender with simplicity and humility, without trying to produce the experience or understand it completely.

entries.title: Quinta Morada.Capítulo 2.
entries.caption: Teresa describe una transformación en la que la vida empieza a apoyarse en Cristo y cambia lo que el alma desea. Soltar los apegos la dispone para amar y servir con más fuerza, aunque la paz recibida conviva con nuevas inquietudes y sufrimientos.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa describes a transformation in which life begins to rest in Christ and the soul’s desires change. Letting go of attachments prepares it to love and serve more wholeheartedly, even as the peace received coexists with new restlessness and suffering.

entries.title: Quinta Morada.Capítulo 3.
entries.caption: Para Teresa, la unión con Dios también se vive al conformar la voluntad con la suya, sin necesitar experiencias extraordinarias. Su señal más clara es el amor al prójimo: aliviar sufrimientos, alegrarse del bien ajeno y convertir los buenos deseos en obras.
entries.summaryEN: For Teresa, union with God can also be lived by aligning our will with His, without extraordinary experiences. Its clearest sign is love of neighbour: relieving suffering, rejoicing in another person’s good, and turning good intentions into actions.

entries.title: Quinta Morada.Capítulo 4.
entries.caption: Teresa presenta la unión como un encuentro de amor que llama a seguir creciendo. Cuidarlo exige oración, humildad y atención a la vida cotidiana: el amor al prójimo y las virtudes muestran si avanzamos o si el amor propio nos está apartando de Dios.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa presents union as an encounter of love that calls for continued growth. Nurturing it requires prayer, humility, and attention to daily life: love of neighbour and the virtues reveal whether we are progressing or self-centredness is drawing us away from God.

entries.title: Sexta Morada.Capítulo 1.
entries.caption: Teresa describe pruebas exteriores y una oscuridad interior en la que el alma deja de sentir el consuelo de Dios, aunque su gracia permanezca. Invita a atravesarlas con humildad, sostenerse en su misericordia y realizar obras de caridad mientras vuelve la claridad.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa describes outward trials and an inward darkness in which the soul no longer feels God’s consolation, even though His grace remains. She encourages humility, trust in His mercy, and works of charity while waiting for clarity to return.

entries.title: Sexta Morada.Capítulo 2.
entries.caption: Teresa describe una cercanía de Dios que trae paz y, a la vez, un deseo más profundo de unión con Él. Es un don que no se puede forzar y que invita a responder con gratitud, servicio y una vida más entregada.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa describes a closeness to God that brings peace while deepening the longing for union with Him. This gift cannot be forced; it calls for gratitude, service, and a more devoted life.

entries.title: Sexta Morada.Capítulo 3.
entries.caption: Teresa invita a examinar las palabras interiores por sus frutos: paz duradera, humildad y mayor deseo de servir a Dios. La certeza personal exige prudencia; antes de actuar en asuntos importantes o que afectan a otros, pide consultar a un confesor instruido.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa encourages examining inward words through their fruits: lasting peace, humility, and a greater desire to serve God. Personal certainty calls for prudence; before acting on important matters or those affecting others, she asks that an informed confessor be consulted.

entries.title: Sexta Morada.Capítulo 4.
entries.caption: Teresa describe una cercanía con Dios que renueva al alma y le da valor para entregarse a Él. Aunque no pueda explicar todo lo recibido, queda un conocimiento más profundo de su grandeza y un deseo de alabarlo, servirlo y desprenderse de los propios intereses.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa describes a closeness to God that renews the soul and gives it courage to surrender to Him. Even when it cannot explain everything received, a deeper knowledge of His greatness remains, with a desire to praise, serve, and release its own interests.

entries.title: Sexta Morada.Capítulo 5.
entries.caption: El vuelo del espíritu muestra, para Teresa, la fuerza de una gracia que el alma no puede gobernar. Recibirla pide confianza y humildad; sus frutos son conocer mejor a Dios, reconocer la propia pequeñez y dar valor a lo que ayuda a servirlo.
entries.summaryEN: For Teresa, the flight of the spirit reveals the power of a grace the soul cannot control. Receiving it calls for trust and humility; its fruits are knowing God more deeply, recognising one’s smallness, and valuing what helps one serve Him.

entries.title: Sexta Morada.Capítulo 6.
entries.caption: Teresa describe un amor que busca la intimidad con Dios y, a la vez, desea que otros lo conozcan y alaben. Entre el anhelo y la alegría, invita a confiar en su voluntad y a valorar las obras y las virtudes más que la intensidad de las emociones.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa describes a love that seeks intimacy with God while longing for others to know and praise Him. Amid longing and joy, she encourages trust in His will and valuing actions and virtues more than the intensity of emotions.

entries.title: Sexta Morada.Capítulo 7.
entries.caption: Para Teresa, las gracias recibidas profundizan la conciencia de las propias faltas y del amor de Dios. Cristo, en su humanidad, sigue siendo guía y compañía: recordar su vida y su entrega ayuda a renovar el amor y a servir aun sin consuelos espirituales.
entries.summaryEN: For Teresa, receiving grace deepens awareness of one’s faults and of God’s love. Christ in His humanity remains a guide and companion: remembering His life and self-giving helps renew love and sustain service, even without spiritual consolation.

entries.title: Sexta Morada.Capítulo 8.
entries.caption: Teresa describe la compañía de Cristo como una presencia que fortalece, da paz y despierta un amor más atento en la vida diaria. Recibirla llama a la gratitud y al servicio; la humildad y las virtudes permiten valorar sus frutos, sin atribuir superioridad a quien recibe este don.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa describes Christ’s company as a presence that strengthens, brings peace, and awakens more attentive love in daily life. Receiving it calls for gratitude and service; humility and the virtues reveal its fruits, without making the recipient superior to others.

entries.title: Sexta Morada.Capítulo 9.
entries.caption: Teresa invita a acoger con prudencia las visiones y a reconocer su valor en una humildad mayor y una vida más virtuosa. Aconseja no buscarlas ni elegir por cuenta propia el camino espiritual: lo esencial es confiar en Dios y servirlo por amor, sin exigir recompensa.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa encourages receiving visions cautiously and recognising their value in greater humility and a more virtuous life. She advises against seeking them or choosing one’s own spiritual path: what matters is trusting God and serving Him out of love, without demanding a reward.

entries.title: Sexta Morada.Capítulo 10.
entries.caption: Teresa entiende la humildad como vivir en la verdad ante Dios y los demás, reconociendo lo recibido y mostrándonos como somos. La paciencia de Dios invita también a perdonar las ofensas y amar a quienes nos hieren, imitando el amor que Él mantiene hacia nosotros.
entries.summaryEN: For Teresa, humility means living truthfully before God and others, acknowledging what we have received and showing ourselves as we are. God’s patience also calls us to forgive offences and love those who hurt us, imitating His enduring love for us.

entries.title: Sexta Morada.Capítulo 11.
entries.caption: Teresa describe un anhelo de Dios tan intenso que se convierte en una profunda prueba interior. El consuelo recibido devuelve fuerzas para vivir según su voluntad; de esta experiencia quedan mayor desprendimiento, valor ante las dificultades y cuidado de no apartarse de Él.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa describes a longing for God so intense that it becomes a profound inward trial. The consolation received restores strength to live according to His will; the experience leaves greater detachment, courage in facing difficulties, and care not to turn away from Him.

entries.title: Séptima Morada.Capítulo 1.
entries.caption: Teresa describe la compañía de la Trinidad en lo más profundo del alma como una presencia que da confianza y sostiene la vida cotidiana. Esa quietud interior puede permanecer entre trabajos y ocupaciones, haciendo al alma más dispuesta a servir a Dios y cuidar su relación con Él.
entries.summaryEN: Teresa describes the Trinity’s company deep within the soul as a presence that brings trust and sustains daily life. This inward quiet can remain amid work and responsibilities, making the soul more ready to serve God and attentive to its relationship with Him.
